name: devbook
description: The devbook convention: .arc42, .domain, .tech, .design, and .ai knowledge folders of addressed Markdown chapters, each carrying a parseable meta block with status ladders, a shared approved rung, runnable test-case links, an opaque ext namespace a layered plugin keeps its own state in, and annotation fences that keep a review note in the chapter beside the passage it is about, compiled into derived _meta indexes and a reference-graph canvas. Ships bidirectional to-spec-<kind> and from-spec-<kind> converters between chapters and code, a versioned contract with runnable migrations, and enforcement tooling. Usable on its own: the per-folder flow-* procedures live in the devbook-flows bridge.
